item.title: LP Giobbi, Steve Angello, Bob Moses & More Set to Headline We Belong Here in Central Park
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music plays in the background]
Host: "Hey there, music lovers! We've got some exciting news for you. The We Belong Here festival is coming back to Central Park in early October, and the headliners have just been announced!"
[Music transitions to a softer beat]
Host: "On Friday, October 2, get ready for MEDUZA³, a hybrid live concept from the Italian trio Meduza, and a sunset hour show from LP Giobbi. The next day, Saturday, October 3, will feature German producer Ben Böhmer and a live show from Stephan Bodzin. And on Sunday, October 4, Swedish DJ Steve Angello and indie electronic duo Bob Moses will take the stage."
[Music picks up again]
Host: "That's not all - the lineup also includes Ashibah, Eve Lauren, and Tripolism, with many more artists to be announced in the coming months. And the best part? You can register for a ticket presale right now!"
[Music transitions to a softer beat again]
Host: "We Belong Here will be taking over the iconic Wollman Rink in Central Park, which will transform into an ice skating rink just a few weekends later. And if you can't make it to the Central Park edition, don't worry - We Belong Here is also hosting festivals in New Orleans and Miami later this year and early next year."
[Music fades out]
Host: "So mark your calendars and get ready to dance! We Belong Here is going to be an unforgettable experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
[Music ends with a final beat]
